evals.name: new-guide-into-new-hub
evals.prompt: /game-guide-hub Hades II — first run, just make it, no questions.
evals.expected_output: Checks game-guide is available, then hands the request to game-guide (does not write guide content itself). After game-guides/hades-ii/ exists, runs build_hub.py, publishes game-guides/index.html as a new Artifact titled 'Game Guides' with every guide file as a supporting file at its relative path, writes the URL into hub.json and runs --mark-published. Reply gives both the guide link and the hub link.

evals.name: sync-legacy-guide-needs-upgrade
evals.expected_output: Build report puts hades-ii in ok and lens-island in needs_upgrade (no guide-meta). Lists the legacy guide and offers the upgrade instead of editing it; on yes, hands it to game-guide as a contract upgrade with no other changes, rebuilds, and publishes only the changed files (report.files). The hub page shows both games once upgraded.
evals.setup: lens-island is an old HTML fragment without guide-meta; hades-ii is a contract-v1 guide.

evals.name: no-artifact-local-hub
evals.prompt: /game-guide-hub sync (session has no Artifact tool — e.g. Claude Code on an API key)
evals.expected_output: Does not try to publish or pretend it published. Builds game-guides/index.html, leaves hub.json mode 'local', tells the player the hub opens straight from disk and that it can be published later from a session that has Artifacts.

evals.name: dlc-variant-dropdown
evals.expected_output: One Elden Ring card, not two; opening it shows the base guide with a variant dropdown offering the DLC guide. Both guides are published as supporting files.
evals.setup: Both guides are contract v1 with game 'elden-ring'.

evals.name: too-new-contract-skipped
evals.expected_output: Reports future-game as too_new (contract 2), skips it without guessing at its fields, and tells the player to update the hub skill.
